children: Ashmore Group's fiscal 2026 underlying performance fell short of market expectations, Cavendish's Rahim Karim and Jens Ehrenberg write in a note. The London-listed emerging markets asset manager has delivered mixed results, they say. While the company reported weaker-than-anticipated adjusted Ebitda, pretax profit rose and was broadly in line with consensus expectations, they note. Additionally, "Ashmore's shares have significantly re-rated in the past nine months, which to a large degree was owing to the perceived inflection in Emerging Markets flows seen across the industry," they add. Shares are down 2% at 2.14 pounds. (najat.kantouar@wsj.com)
